title: Nashville 1BR · Indoor Pool & Hot Tub · Nashville
description:
In Nashville, close to Broadway's honky-tonks, the Ryman, Bridgestone Arena and the Cumberland riverfront. 1-bedroom, 1-bath suite at our resort in Nashville, TN. Sleeps 4. Resort amenities include outdoor pool, indoor pool, outdoor hot tub and fitness center. Send us a message if you have questions before booking.

The space
In the suite: Ceiling fan · Hair dryer · In-room safe · In-suite washer/dryer · DVD player · TV · Wi-Fi · Balcony or patio (in some suites) · Jetted Tub · Air conditioning · Bathtub · Bed linens · Blender · Body soap · Cable TV · Coffee · Coffee maker · Conditioner · Cookware · Dining table · Dishes and silverware · Essentials · Freezer · Hangers · Heating · Iron · Full kitchen · Microwave · Oven · Pack ’n Play/travel crib · Refrigerator · Shampoo · Stove · Toaster · Towels provided

Guest access
You check in at the resort's front desk and can use all of the resort's amenities during your stay.
• Valet is the only parking the resort offers.
• Groceries and shopping are a short drive from the resort.
• The resort takes a refundable $250 damage deposit at check-in (credit or debit card).
• The guest checking in must be 21+ and named on the reservation. Send us their name when you book.

Other things to note
• We're a timeshare owner renting out a week we're not using — we don't own or operate the resort. The reservation is made in your name, so you check in and use the resort like any other guest.
• Photos are of the resort and a suite of this type. Your exact unit is assigned by the resort.
• We book the unit type; the resort assigns the specific suite. We can't guarantee a building or floor.
• Mobility-accessible units are part of the same pool. Let us know your preference and we'll note it.
• The guest checking in must be 21+ and present a credit card for the resort's refundable damage deposit.
• The resort has its own check-in paperwork, plus any local taxes or on-site fees.
• The resort may offer a timeshare presentation. It's optional — you can decline.
• Cancellations are handled under this listing's cancellation policy.
• Resort details come from the resort. Ask us if anything is critical and we'll confirm it.
